title: Support networks aim to help kids through the polycrisis
summary: In a 2021 study measuring climate anxiety, 56% of 10,000 children and young people in 10 countries agreed with the statement “Humanity is doomed.” But there isn’t really a word to describe feelings people have about the rest of what’s going on…
